tools.studio: Main Studio entry point for visual creation on your own account: character/scene/prop assets, the output and reference library, generation jobs, and actual image and video rendering. Pick an operation with `action`. Video always goes through storyboard first (`storyboard_plan` -> `draw_storyboard` -> user approval -> `storyboard_video`); `generate_video` is disabled. Async results differ by action: `generate_image` / `storyboard_video` return `outputs[]` with signed download links or a `pending` result to poll via `studio_outputs`; `process_asset` / `edit_asset` are polled with `get_asset`; narration and montage actions finish synchronously. It also covers motion-graphic drafts, motion template library, Director productions, audio/video plan, folders, social posting and SEO blog actions.
tools.studio_project: Editor (per-shot) projects: list, open, create from a brief or template, change settings, move from review to rendering, and manage saved versions. Use it to start or inspect a project before editing shots with `studio_shots`, layers with `studio_layers`, audio with `studio_audio` and export with `studio_export`. A single spend over 50 HWT first returns `needs_confirmation` with a `confirm_token`; repeat the identical call with the token after the user agrees.
tools.studio_shots: Shot list of an editor project: edit shot fields, reorder, choose which shots to generate, approve or redo, set frames and still cards. `render`, `render_all` and `render_frame` spend HWT and return job ids at once; call `collect` afterwards to adopt finished clips. A single spend over 50 HWT first returns `needs_confirmation` with a `confirm_token`.
tools.studio_layers: On-screen overlay layers (titles, captions, stickers) for an editor project. Use `recipes` to find overlay recipe ids, then `set` / `add` / `remove` layers and `preview` a given second as a PNG.
tools.studio_audio: Audio plan of an editor project: pacing, narration lines, music cues and final mix. Write and check the plan for free, then `narrate` (paid TTS) and `mix` into the final video.
tools.studio_director: AI director for an editor project: write a script, re-plan shots, apply scene templates, run a co-director turn and auto-assign references. A restorable version is saved before each call. `plan`, `script`, `smart` and `cast` spend HWT; a single spend over 50 HWT needs a `confirm_token` confirmation first.
tools.studio_export: Stitch the final video of an editor project and produce a top/bottom comparison export. Start stitching, then poll `stitch_status` for the result.
tools.studio_library: Folders and the combined library of outputs and uploads. Use it to list, create, rename, delete folders and move outputs or assets between them.
tools.studio_create: Create-page flow (steps 1-4) plus the featured video templates: Cinematic Cut (`cctvcut`) and Highlight Cut (`hlcut`). Flow: references, then storyboard board, then pick model/style, then `cut` to render. References are given as `{pillar,id}`, `{asset_id}` or `{output_id}`. Call `guide` first for the steps and all options; `storyboard_draw` and `cut` spend HWT and a storyboard version approved by the user is required before `cut`.
tools.studio_clipper: Long-video highlight clipper: a long video is transcribed word by word, AI picks highlights, and short 9:16 vertical clips are rendered. The default motion-edit style is the note-explainer layout (hook, persistent topic title, word-by-word captions, paper-collage illustrations, Instagram copy); `layout: motion` keeps the original motion look. Use `quote` for prices, `analyze` to find candidates, then `render` or `render_range` to cut clips.
tools.studio_talk_reel: Speaker Reel (motion-graphics director template): turns a video of a person talking into a fully automatic polished 9:16 reel. It does word-level transcription with dead-air cutting (pauses, fillers, stutters; spoken words are never cut), subject cut-out framing, word-by-word captions with keyword emphasis, motion text timed to the speech, and voice cleanup with sound effects and loudness. Duration must be 3-180 seconds with speech. One flat fee covers the first render plus 3 re-renders via director notes.
tools.studio_footage: Footage brain: turn the user's uploaded videos or folders (footage sets, already analyzed into the library) into an edited video from a single sentence. It picks the best segments, removes repeated lines and filler, adds cover footage and multilingual captions, produces a free preview first, and renders the final video only after the user approves.
tools.studio_compiler: Compiler: turns plain-language text plus assets into a validated script, then renders with a chosen video model. `compile` and `refine` charge a small analysis fee; `run` submits rendering. Check results with `job`.
tools.studio_longcut: Long-video stitching: one brief becomes a segmented plan draft (free to review), then segments are generated in the background and joined into one long video. Use `plan` first, have the user review it, then `run` and poll `status`.
tools.studio_assets: Character/scene/prop asset details: reference lists usable in creation, versions, viewing cover images, memories, character voice, and deletion. Listing, single details, rename, version selection and new versions stay in `studio` (`list_assets`, `get_asset`, `rename_asset`, `select_version`, `edit_asset`).
tools.studio_outputs: Single entry point for downloading or previewing any produced file: `output_id`, `asset_id` or `job_id` becomes a signed `download_url` (`media_url` for web playback). Watermarking follows your plan, same as Studio. Links expire after 2-8 hours; call `get` again for a fresh one.
tools.studio_storyboard: Animated storyboard: plays the storyboard inside the conversation with an embedded player and waits for the user's approval before rendering. Flow: `studio_create.storyboard`, then `draw`, then `show`, then the user approves, then `approve`, then `studio.storyboard_video`. Rendering actions check that the storyboard has been approved.
tools.studio_cast: Character selection: before a storyboard or render, ask the user which character from the character library should be the lead. Hosts that support MCP Apps show a character card to tap; other hosts give the user a `pick_url` web page, or the user answers with a number and you call `choose`. After picking, pass `args.cast_pick:<pick_id>` to the storyboard or render call.
tools.studio_confirm: Approval cards for spending and permissions. When an action returns `needs_confirmation` + `confirm_token` (or `needs_permission` + `permission_token`), call `show` to display the card, then call `wait` (up to 50 seconds per call; call again while `open`). On `approved` repeat the original call with identical args plus the token; on `declined` do not proceed. With `approval: "user"` (only when the key's owner turned on page approval) only the user can approve, on the `approve_url` page on AlgoHash while signed in; a yes in chat does not count and `decide` cannot approve. Hosts without cards should give the user the `approve_url`.
tools.studio_browse: Library card: shows the user's characters, scenes, props and works in the conversation with thumbnails and search; the user picks items and taps use-as-reference, and the picks come back as conversation messages (`avatars/<id>`, `output_id <id>`) to put in `refs`. Hosts without MCP Apps read the text list instead.
tools.studio_collage: Collage long-take (Director mode / Create card): a narration becomes one visual metaphor per sentence, built as a stop-motion of halftone black-and-white photo cut-outs and color swatches on flat colored paper. `flow` mode is one continuous take with a carry-over object crossing every sentence boundary; `solo` rebuilds each sentence from empty paper. Gates: pick concept, approve metaphors per sentence, approve stills (paid), render first/last-frame animations (paid), then free stitching and QA. The final film has no audio track. `auto {brief, budget_hwt}` runs everything as an AI director, then loop `auto_step`. Call `guide` first.
tools.studio_paper: Paper Explainer: a topic becomes a vertical explainer video of up to 30 seconds where the whole frame is a paper model: paper backgrounds, characters and props pop in piece by piece, with paper transitions, camera moves, handwritten marks, tape titles, word-by-word captions, voice, music and sound effects. An image model only draws the elements and animation is done by a motion template, so it is not a generated video. Use it when the user asks for paper craft, cut paper, paper collage, diorama or an explainer reel (use `studio_collage` for an existing narration as a one-take collage). Gates: approve script, draw elements (paid), voice track (free), approve storyboard (free stills), render (paid). Follow `next`; rendering requires an approved storyboard. Call `guide` first.

actions.studio.match_cast: Match a character/scene/prop name the user gave to a library asset; ambiguous matches return `ambiguous` for the user to pick (`ad_chat`, `generate_image`, `storyboard_plan` already do this).
actions.studio.list_gallery: List generated images and videos (`kind:'outputs'`) or the uploaded reference library (`kind:'assets'`); filter by `media` for image or video.
actions.studio.search_library: Search the user's own images, videos and assets by description (semantic plus keyword); shows a card, and result ids work directly as refs (`{output_id}`/`{asset_id}`).
actions.studio.list_jobs: Check generation job status (queued/running/completed/error); use it when the user asks whether a generation is done.
actions.studio.select_version: Select a version of an asset.
actions.studio.import_reference_video: Paid: import a video from a supported platform URL into the library at a fixed fee; fully refunded on failure.
actions.studio.get_production: Get one production's details: storyboard and per-shot progress.
actions.studio.list_video_models: Report per-video-model price for the given spec plus min/max duration (use when the user asks which is cheapest or how much).
actions.studio.list_image_styles: List photo layout templates (image only); without `style_cat` returns categories, `style_cat:'atelier'` returns the 22 jewelry/watch studio-shoot styles.
actions.studio.get_image_style: Get one template's fields, all dropdown options and how to render it (free); render with `generate_image` using `style_id`, `style_values` and `refs`.
actions.studio.search_motion_templates: Search the motion template library (313 third-party templates ranked S/A/B/C; free); results include `preview_url`, `tier` and `layer_guess` (layerable or fullframe).
actions.studio.get_motion_template: Get one template in full: prompt, props (fields and defaults), composition (size/fps/frames), license and attribution; `include_code:true` adds the source.
actions.studio.preview_motion_template: Render a still frame of the template on the server (free; this is the storyboard and goes into the Storyboard folder).
actions.studio.render_motion_template: Paid: render the template to video after the user approved the storyboard; billed per second, pass `preview_job_id`; `transparent:true` gives a transparent-background overlay.
actions.studio.motion_render_status: Check the status of a motion template render.
actions.studio.fork_motion_template: Copy a template into the user's own fork when props cannot give the effect; then `edit_motion_fork`, `preview_motion_template {fork_id}`, and after approval `render_motion_template {fork_id}`.
actions.studio.edit_motion_fork: Edit a template fork (find/replace patches, helper files, size/duration meta); an edit that does not compile is not saved and the error location is returned.
actions.studio.motion_fork_source: Get the source of a template fork.
actions.studio.restore_motion_fork: Restore a template fork to an earlier state.
actions.studio.list_scene_templates: List the 35 ready-made scene templates (each shot has a first frame and camera move written), so a pick gives a full storyboard.
actions.studio.generate_scene_template: Generate a storyboard on the fly when the topic is not among the 35 templates (free, three shots by default); pass an id to extend that production three shots at a time.
actions.studio.apply_scene_template: Apply a template (a ready `template_id` or one just generated) to a production (free, no generation).
actions.studio.estimate_cost: Estimate the HWT cost of a generation as a cost card.
actions.studio.generate_image: Paid: actually generate images; charges HWT and the result shows automatically in the conversation.
actions.studio.generate_video: Disabled; use the storyboard flow and `storyboard_video` instead.
actions.studio.create_asset: Create a new character/scene/prop draft from one reference image (free).
actions.studio.process_asset: Paid: process a draft so it becomes `ready`.
actions.studio.edit_asset: Paid: edit an existing asset to produce a new version.
actions.studio.analyze_refs: Have AI look at reference images and produce a description / style profile.
actions.studio.ad_questions: Produce a creative questionnaire for the user to answer.
actions.studio.ad_prompt: Turn the answers into a professional prompt (image, video or packet).
actions.studio.ad_chat: Discuss the creative idea conversationally; `finalize:true` closes it into a prompt.
actions.studio.ad_storyboard: Turn a prompt into a shot table (per-shot shot size, camera move, seconds).
actions.studio.storyboard_plan: Director-level shot breakdown for `sb_style` `cinematic`, `highlight`, `oner` or `explainer` (size, angle, move, lens, composition, characters per shot); free, saved to the storyboard board.
actions.studio.draw_storyboard: Paid: draw a `storyboard_plan` version as a storyboard image (one image); an animated storyboard card appears and the user can play it shot by shot.
actions.studio.storyboard_revise: Create a new version from a given one following an `instruction` (free; `panel` edits just one shot), then draw again with `draw_storyboard`.
actions.studio.storyboard_video: Paid: render a video with no source clip, shot by shot following a storyboard version and its storyboard image as references; `draw_storyboard` must be done first.
actions.studio.save_storyboard: Write the storyboard into the production (moves it to pending approval).
actions.studio.accept_storyboard: After the user approves, open the gate to rendering.
actions.studio.montage_production: Build a per-shot keyframe montage to review before rendering (free).
actions.studio.finalize_production: Finish the production and produce the final video in one go.
actions.studio.stitch_production: Stitch the per-shot clips into the final output (free); every ticked shot must have a `record_clip` first, and missing shots are named.
actions.studio.get_av_plan: Get the audio/video plan (pacing, narration, music, loudness).
actions.studio.check_shot_plan: Free check that catches repetitive shots and whether per-shot durations fit the target total length.
actions.studio.plan_music: Write music section cues (free; one source per section, used to split long videos; generate+text requires a `prompt_seed`).
actions.studio.preview_narration: Paid: try one spoken line (needs a shot; small cost).
actions.studio.synthesize_narration: Paid and destructive (needs `confirm: true`): synthesize the whole narration set.
actions.studio.move_to_folder: Folder organization: move items into a folder.
actions.studio.use_output_as_input: Turn an output into a reference for the next generation.
actions.studio.upload_asset: Add a file to the asset library from a URL or base64.
actions.studio.social_accounts: Check whether each platform (Instagram, Threads, Facebook, ...) is connected, plus the `connect_url`.
actions.studio.ig_recent_media: Recent Instagram posts and their performance.
actions.studio.ig_list_posts: List posts on the calendar (filter by `platform`).
actions.studio.ig_schedule_post: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): schedule a post on the calendar.
actions.studio.ig_update_post: Edit or delete a scheduled post: edit.
actions.studio.ig_delete_post: Edit or delete a scheduled post: delete.
actions.studio.ig_caption: AI-write a caption and hashtags (does not publish).
actions.studio.blog_styles: SEO cover image styles (13), compositions and cover unit price.
actions.studio.blog_sites: List the user's blogs (settings and embed code).
actions.studio.blog_site_save: Create or edit a blog's settings (domain allowlist, theme, layout, language, brand, `brand_md` brand guide).
actions.studio.blog_list_posts: List SEO articles on the calendar.
actions.studio.blog_create_post: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): schedule an SEO article (`generate:true` writes it and renders the cover now, with a cover fee; it goes live at the scheduled time).
actions.studio.blog_update_post: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): edit an article's title, time or content.
actions.studio.blog_generate: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): regenerate (`only=article|image`); charges a fee and.
actions.studio.blog_embed_code: Get the embed code (script, iframe, feed, RSS).
actions.studio.social_comments: Comments and replies on posts (Instagram, Facebook Page including visitor posts, Threads); `conversation_of` returns the full conversation of one Threads reply.
actions.studio.social_insights: Account and per-post metrics (reach, views, engagement, followers); `days` up to 30.
actions.studio.social_reply: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): publicly reply to a comment as the account (needs `target_id` and `text`).
actions.studio.social_hide: Hide or unhide a comment (`hidden:false` unhides).
actions.studio.social_delete: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete a comment; Threads does not allow deletion, only `social_hide`.
actions.studio.social_like: Like a comment as the Page (Facebook only).
actions.studio.social_dm_flows: List comment-to-DM flows (Chat Gate Instagram: a comment triggers a private message with buttons, finally handed to AI).
actions.studio.social_dm_flow_save: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): create or edit a flow; `flow={media_id?, trigger:'all'|'keyword', keywords, public_reply?, steps:[{id, text, buttons:[{title, goto|url}], handoff}]}`.
actions.studio.social_dm_flow_enable: Turn a flow on or off (`flow_id` + `enabled`).
actions.studio.brand_create_post: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): publish a public post.
actions.studio.motion_direct: Paid: AI director: from a `brief`, `script` or `reference` it segments, applies the brand, writes scenes, checks and renders as a background job; returns `job_id`, `status`, `question`, `gate`.
actions.studio.motion_direct_status: Check progress of an AI director job (`job_id`).
actions.studio.motion_direct_reply: Paid: relay the user's answer to an AI director job (`job_id` + `gate_id` from the result's `gate.gate_id` + `approve`, optional `notes` / `asset_id`); continuing is billed by actual tokens.
actions.studio.motion_direct_cancel: Cancel an AI director job (the draft is kept).
actions.studio.get_motion_catalog: Motion graphics effect catalog with one line per effect; pass `catalog_section` (grammars, art, presets, templates, transitions, music, examples) for that section's parameters and how to call it.
actions.studio.get_motion_draft: Per-element listing of a draft, each element with an address (e.g. `s2.c3` = scene 2 beat 3, `s2.c3.text`, `s1.text.brand`, `s1.color.bg`).
actions.studio.motion_create: Paid: create an animation from a `prompt`, `example`, `motion_template` (+ `template_params`) or `preset`; `plan_only:true` returns just an outline, then `motion_create {plan_id}`.
actions.studio.motion_revise: Paid: revise a draft in plain language (`id` + `prompt`; `scene` / `target` limit it to a scene or element); billed by text-model tokens.
actions.studio.motion_edit: Edit elements directly by address (`id` + `edits`; no AI, instant): text, color, timing, icon, numbers, add or delete beats, add scenes, swap the style preset, reorder scenes.
actions.studio.motion_open: Open a draft in the user's open Studio (`id`); `mode:'export'` makes that Studio export an MP4 and needs Studio open.
actions.studio.motion_ref: Paid: break a reference ad video (`asset_id`) into 3-8 cut-based segments as a black-and-white draft; 30-36 HWT, repeats free, max 120 s; copies structure only, never the reference's brand.
actions.studio.motion_ref_status: Check breakdown progress or result (`ref_id`; free).
actions.studio.motion_ref_reread: Paid: have AI re-read one segment (`ref_id` + `section`, optional `hint`); costs 5 HWT, fully refunded on failure.
actions.studio.list_motion_refs: List the user's reference breakdowns (`ref_id`, status, segment count, `draft_id`; free).
actions.studio.motion_ref_quote: Quote a reference breakdown without charging (`asset_id`, optional `in_sec` / `out_sec`): duration, segment count, `fee_hwt`, whether cached.
actions.studio.set_motion_ref_bounds: Re-segment by dragging boundaries (`ref_id` + `bounds:[start second of each segment...]`, first is the start, increasing, 1-12 segments; no AI, instant, free).
actions.studio.delete_motion_ref: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete a reference breakdown (`ref_id`); drafts it produced are kept.
actions.studio.list_motion_jobs: List the user's AI director jobs (`job_id`, status, pending question, `draft_id`).
actions.studio.list_motion_brands: List the user's brand kits (`brand_id`, name, colors, font, logo).
actions.studio.save_motion_brand: Create or edit a brand kit via `brand:{name, tagline?, cta?, url?, palette?, font?, motion?, look?, logo?, mark?}`; `brand_id` edits, `make_default:true` sets default; free.
actions.studio.delete_motion_brand: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete a brand kit (`brand_id`); drafts that used it keep their own snapshot.
actions.studio.delete_motion_draft: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete a motion draft (`id`); exported videos stay in the library.
actions.studio.get_motion_history: Draft activity (`id`): who changed what, one line per group; groups with `undo_grp` / `job_id` can be undone; free.
actions.studio.list_motion_versions: List a draft's versions (`id`; automatic snapshots and named); with `version_id` shows that version's outline.
actions.studio.restore_motion_version: Restore a draft to a version (`id` + `version_id`); can be undone with `undo_motion`.
actions.studio.undo_motion: Undo a draft change (`id` + `undo_grp` or `job_id` for a whole AI director job); `redo:true` redoes.
actions.studio.export_motion_draft: Paid: render a draft to MP4 into the library (`id`, `motion_resolution` 720p/1080p, `motion_fps` 30/60); 30 HWT per second, refunded on error/cancel; identical earlier export returns `cached` free.
actions.studio.motion_export_status: Check server render progress or result (`job_id`); when done, `asset_id` or `output_id` go to `studio_outputs.get` for the download link.
actions.studio.cancel_motion_export: Cancel a server render; nothing is saved to the library.
actions.studio_project.get: Full project: settings, shots, stills, overlays, av_plan, final output
actions.studio_project.create: New project without a source video. body: {origin: template|brief|production, template_id|brief|production_id, ratio?, workflow?, shot_count?, language?}
actions.studio_project.analyze: Paid: reverse a reference video into an editable project. body: `{source, title?, mode?, chunk_sec?, language?}`.
actions.studio_project.composite: Compose mode: build a new free project from already-rendered shots of other projects. body: `{title?, pieces:[{rid, n, in?, out?}], audio?, unify?, strength?, join?}`.
actions.studio_project.settings: Change workflow, resolution, ratio, gen_mode, vo_language, title, refs…
actions.studio_project.replan: Re-cut a reference-video project's shot grid without re-analysing (review only; shot text is inherited by time overlap). body: {mode: fixed|merge|trim, chunk_sec, workflow}
actions.studio_project.reblueprint: Re-extract per-shot subject / location / on-screen text when the analysis left them empty (free, does not re-watch the video)
actions.studio_project.notes: Turn the analysed transcript and shots into study notes (free, no re-analysis). body: {focus?, language?}
actions.studio_project.start: review → rendering (shots can be generated after this)
actions.studio_project.variant: Clone as another language version. body: {language}
actions.studio_project.translate: Translate voice-over and on-screen text. body: {language|languages}
actions.studio_project.version_fields: Per-shot text fields of a saved version (compare an old version with the current shots; read-only)
actions.studio_project.estimate: Exact HWT price to render the project's shots. args: {only?: [n…]}
actions.studio_project.strip: View the film strip of the whole source video (returns an image).
actions.studio_shots.patch: Edit shot fields. body: {shots:[{n, ff_desc?, motion_desc?, vo_text?, on_screen_text?, refs?, …}]}
actions.studio_shots.add: Append an LLM-written shot to a scene. body: {brief, refs?, after?}
actions.studio_shots.select: Choose which shots to generate; the rest keep the source clip. body: {generate:[n…]}
actions.studio_shots.frame_from_output: Use a library image as a frame. body: {output_id, role: first|end|mid}
actions.studio_shots.redo: Send a shot back for another take
actions.studio_shots.keep: Keep the source clip for this shot. body: {keep: bool}
actions.studio_shots.import: Copy a shot from another project. body: {from_rid, from_n, with_frame?, with_clip?, with_dur?}
actions.studio_shots.reframe: Change aspect ratio. body: {ratio, mode: crop|pad}
actions.studio_shots.vo_suggest: Write a voice-over line for the shot
actions.studio_shots.libclip: Put a library video into this shot. args `{mode: use|ref|'', ref:{asset_id|output_id, in?}}`: `use` plays it from `in` (free), `ref` feeds the model's video slot, `''` clears.
actions.studio_shots.libclip_isolate: Keep a library clip's picture and sound separately. body: {video: bool, audio: bool} (video off + audio on = generate the shot and lip-sync to the clip's sound)
actions.studio_shots.clear_voice: Remove the user's own recorded voice from a shot
actions.studio_shots.add_still: Cover/ending/poster card. body: {output_id, kind, after_n, dur, label?}
actions.studio_shots.render: Paid: submit one shot for rendering and return at once with its `job_id`; then call `collect`.
actions.studio_shots.render_all: Paid: submit every pending shot that is not already generating; returns job ids at once, then call `collect`. args `{only?}`.
actions.studio_shots.render_frame: Paid: submit an opening/end frame image; returns `job_id`. args `{role?}`; then collect with `args.frame_jobs`.
actions.studio_shots.collect: Check submitted jobs: adopts finished clips into their shots and logs failed ones (auto-refunded). args `{frame_jobs?:[{shot, job_id}]}`.
actions.studio_shots.head: View the first frame of this shot's source clip (returns an image).
actions.studio_shots.genstrip: View the film strip of this shot's generated clip (returns an image).
actions.studio_layers.set: Replace the whole overlay layer list (max 24). body: `{layers:[{recipe, at, duration, props, shot?, off?}]}`.
actions.studio_layers.add: Append one layer. args: {recipe, at, duration, props}
actions.studio_layers.recipes: Overlay recipe catalog (ids for layers). args: {lane?: overlay|cam|edit, cat?, lang?}
actions.studio_layers.preview: Preview the overlay effect at a given second (returns a PNG). args `{at}`.
actions.studio_audio.get: Audio/video plan with summary, errors, warnings
actions.studio_audio.set: Write the plan; returns 409 when it has errors. body: `{plan}`.
actions.studio_audio.mix: Mix audio into the final video and run final checks
actions.studio_director.draft: Draft from a brief. body: `{brief, keep_structure?, with_frames?, targets?}`.
actions.studio_director.plan: Paid: LLM re-plan of the shots. body: `{brief, shots?, keep_structure?, language?, rendition?: "cine"}` (`cine` = film/TV-grade rendition with a cinematic move per shot).
actions.studio_director.script: Paid: LLM script from a brief. body: `{brief, total_sec?, dry_run?, language?}`.
actions.studio_director.template: Apply a scene template. body: `{template_id, shots?, keep_structure?, dry_run?}`.
actions.studio_director.smart: Paid: one AI co-director turn; returns ops. body: `{message, sel?, language?}`.
actions.studio_director.auto_slots: Auto-fill reference slots. body: `{shots?, overwrite?, brief?}`.
actions.studio_director.casting_adopt: Adopt a finished casting image: saves it to the library as a character/location and binds it to the project. body: `{name, job_id}`.
actions.studio_director.import_production: Import a Director production's storyboard onto this project's shots; already-paid keyframes come along free. body: `{production_id, shots?:[n…], with_frames?}`.
actions.studio_director.clear_smart: Clear the AI co-director conversation (versions are kept)
actions.studio_director.cast: Paid: generate one casting image (character or scene). args `{name, prompt?}` returns `job_id`; collect it with `studio_shots.collect` using `args.cast_jobs`.
actions.studio_export.stitch: Stitch the final video. body: `{subs?, background?, shots?, preview?}`.
actions.studio_export.stitch_and_wait: Start stitching the final video and return at once; then poll `stitch_status`.
actions.studio_library.move: Move outputs or assets into a folder. body: `{to, output_ids?, asset_ids?}`.
actions.studio_create.guide: Walk through Create steps 1-4 and the two featured templates, which action to use at each step, and all options (models, hook styles, visual styles, character language, material roles).
actions.studio_create.quote: Quote: args `{template: cctvcut|hlcut, video, clip_in?, clip_out?, refs?, model?, resolution?}`; returns HWT per model, template fee included.
actions.studio_create.storyboard: Step 2 storyboard (free, AI watches the video); returns `{version, plan_id, fee_hwt}`; `pending` = retry in 10 s; unmatched character returns `needs_cast` (retry with `args.cast_pick`).
actions.studio_create.storyboard_draw: Paid: draw a storyboard version as one storyboard image. args `{seed?, model?, draw_style?, arrows?}`; `model` is an image model id or `"user"`; price follows the model.
actions.studio_create.storyboard_versions: List all versions of a storyboard board (`status`, qc checks, `output_id`).
actions.studio_create.storyboard_revise: Revise the storyboard in plain language (free), creating a new version; args `{instruction}`; without `instruction` it just redraws a new version unchanged.
actions.studio_create.storyboard_clear: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): clear the draft versions of the whole storyboard board (finished storyboard images stay in the library).
actions.studio_create.cut: Paid: render the video (Cinematic/Highlight Cut); returns `job_id`. `storyboard` (user-approved version id) is required; `clip_in`/`clip_out` (≤30 s segment) are billed by length.
actions.studio_create.cut_recompose: Rebuild the top/bottom split view when the AI video finished but the split was not produced (free, idempotent).
actions.studio_clipper.quote: Quote: args `{source:{asset_id|output_id}}` gives the analysis price; args `{clip_durs:[seconds…], layout?, note?:{collage}}` gives the render price per clip.
actions.studio_clipper.analyze: Paid: analyze a long video (word-level transcript plus highlight scoring). args `{source:{asset_id|output_id}, count: auto|3|5|8, length: short|mid|long, title?}`; returns an `id`.
actions.studio_clipper.get: Get an analysis's status, candidate clips (`id`, `t0`, `t1`, `title`, score) and rendered clips.
actions.studio_clipper.thumb: View a candidate clip's thumbnail (returns an image).
actions.studio_clipper.render: Paid: render one vertical clip. args `{clip:{id,t0,t1,title}, layout: track|fit|orig|reel|motion|note, note?, captions?, title?, cut_pauses?, cut_fillers?}`; `note` = note-explainer style.
actions.studio_clipper.render_range: Paid: cut a segment directly. args `{source:{asset_id|output_id, in, out}, title?, layout?, note?, captions?}`; the video must be analyzed first, otherwise `needs_analyze`.
actions.studio_clipper.render_status: Status of a render order (`ready` means the output exists).
actions.studio_talk_reel.guide: Explain the flow, styles, options, director-note chips and how cut-out is handled.
actions.studio_talk_reel.styles: List all styles (id, background, three colors, type feel, sound effects).
actions.studio_talk_reel.quote: Quote: args `{source:{asset_id|output_id}}`; returns `fee_hwt` (flat fee including 3 re-renders) and duration.
actions.studio_talk_reel.start: Paid: open an order, charging the flat fee. args `{source:{asset_id|output_id}, style?, mode?: auto|step, captions?, sfx?, backdrop?, matte?, music?, title?, language?, …}`; returns a job id.
actions.studio_talk_reel.list: List recent speaker reels (id, status, style, duration, output).
actions.studio_talk_reel.get: Get one order: status, progress, transcript with pause/stumble list, scene plan, report, versions, `revisions_left`, and a suggested next step.
actions.studio_talk_reel.words: Transcript review gate (`review_words`): args `{fix:[{i, w}], keep_pauses:[k], keep_stumbles:[k]}` to correct words (`i` = word index) and keep the listed pauses/stumbles; the rest are cut.
actions.studio_talk_reel.plan: Plan review gate (`review_plan`): args `{keys:[{s, i}], scenes:[{id, drop?, kind?, layer?, fields?, word_i?}]}` to change a sentence's keyword and edit scenes.
actions.studio_talk_reel.next: Pass a gate: `review_words` leads to the plan, `review_plan` leads to rendering (already covered by the flat fee).
actions.studio_talk_reel.notes: Director note: produce a new version (3 included in the flat fee). args `{text?, chip?, range?:[start_sec, end_sec], scene?, frames?, colors?}`; `chip` is one of the note chips from `guide`.
actions.studio_talk_reel.cancel: Cancel: before the first version it cancels with a full refund; after a version exists nothing changes and outputs are kept.
actions.studio_footage.sets: List the user's footage sets (id, name, number of videos, analysis status).
actions.studio_footage.search: Search a footage set for segments by meaning, not exact words. args `{set_id, q}`.
actions.studio_footage.auto: Fully automatic draft (free): creates an edit and a free preview. args `{set_id, brief, ratio?, captions?:[lang], target_sec?, broll?, layout?}`.
actions.studio_footage.edit_get: Get edit details (status, preview, EDL). args `{edit_id}`.
actions.studio_footage.edit_update: Update an edit; it reverts to draft. args `{edit_id, edl?, name?}` where the EDL holds the main track `a`, `broll`, `captions` and `ratio`.
actions.studio_footage.preview: Render a free low-resolution watermarked preview. args `{edit_id}`.
actions.studio_footage.render: Paid: render the final video, billed by output seconds and fully refunded if it cannot be produced. args `{edit_id}`.
actions.studio_footage.tighten: Tightening suggestions (free): removes repeated lines, filler and long pauses. args `{clips:[{asset,in,out}]}`.
actions.studio_footage.broll: Cover-footage suggestions (free, does not change the edit); returns broll items to put in the EDL and apply via `edit_update`. args `{a:[{asset,in,out}], layout?}`.
actions.studio_footage.broll_ai: Paid: generate one AI cover image, charged per image separately from the render price. args `{text, ratio?, at?, dur?}` where `text` is the line being spoken.
actions.studio_footage.broll_ai_get: Progress of an AI cover image. args `{job_id}`.
actions.studio_compiler.options: Menu of use cases, limits, director styles and models.
actions.studio_compiler.compile: Paid: turn plain-language text plus assets into a script. args `{text, assets, seconds, aspect, shots?, creativity?, dialogue_language?, no_music?, director?}`; `@name` refers to assets.
actions.studio_compiler.refine: Paid: edit the script in plain language. args are the same as `compile` plus `{change}`.
actions.studio_compiler.adapt: Convert a script into render parameters for a model without rendering. args `{result, model, resolution?, aspect?}`.
actions.studio_compiler.run: Paid: adapt and immediately submit the render; same args as `adapt`, returns `job_id` (then call `job {job_id}`).
actions.studio_compiler.job: Status and output of any render or image job.
actions.studio_longcut.plan: Draft a segment plan (free, nothing is generated). args `{brief, target_sec, model?, resolution?, language?, audio?:{asset_id}}`.
actions.studio_longcut.run: Paid: submit a reviewed plan; returns `job_id`. args `{plan:{segments, model, resolution, refs?:[{pillar,id}…], audio?:{asset_id}, subtitle_mode?}}`.
actions.studio_longcut.status: Status of a long-video job (`completed` or `error`, per-segment progress).
actions.studio_assets.ref_sources: References usable in a creation (characters, props, scenes, style images, each with `id`, `label`, `kind`, `cover`); `args.q` picks by description ranked by relevance, otherwise the latest.
actions.studio_assets.versions: All versions of an asset (which is active, when each was made).
actions.studio_assets.view: View an asset image (returns an image). args `{which: cover|ref|fullbody (character)|aerial (scene), version?}`.
actions.studio_assets.memories: Record of prompts that generated successfully with this character/scene as the lead, for continuing a style.
actions.studio_assets.add_memory: Record a successful generation (later used by `ad_questions` / `ad_prompt`). args `{prompt, model?, output_id?}`.
actions.studio_assets.voice: Whether a character has a bound voice (avatars); returns a preview link if so.
actions.studio_assets.delete_voice: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete a character's voice recording.
actions.studio_assets.delete: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete an asset (cannot be recovered); always ask the user first.
actions.studio_outputs.get: Get signed download links. args `{output_ids?:[≤20], asset_ids?:[≤10], job_id?, wait_sec?: 0-20}`; unfinished items return `pending` + `retry_after_sec`, so call again.
actions.studio_outputs.show: Same as `get` plus up to 4 small preview images (max 8 items per call; previews total ≤72KB, those that do not fit are listed in `previews_skipped`, download links still returned).
actions.studio_storyboard.show: Play the animated storyboard in the conversation. args `{version?, panel?, autoplay?}`; returns `shots[]` and a signed `sheet_url`; call again to jump to a shot.
actions.studio_storyboard.approve: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): record the user's approval of this version; only after they said approve. args `{video_style?}`: realistic (default), film, commercial, anime, animation3d, match.
actions.studio_storyboard.draw: Paid: draw an undrawn storyboard version as one image; call only when the user explicitly asks. args `{model?, seed?, draw_style?, arrows?}` as in `studio_create.storyboard_draw`.
actions.studio_storyboard.revise: Revise the storyboard in plain language (free, creates a new version that must be redrawn with `draw`). args `{instruction}`; without it a new version is drawn unchanged.
actions.studio_cast.pick: Open a character picker (all ready characters, or those in `args.ids`); returns `pick_id`, `pick_url`, numbered candidates and thumbnails.
actions.studio_cast.show: Show the picker again (the `pick_id` returned by `needs_cast`). args `{pick_id}`.
actions.studio_cast.choose: Record which character the user picked (the embedded card calls this itself; if the user answers a number or name in conversation, you call it). args `{pick_id, ids?|ns?|none?}`.
actions.studio_cast.thumbs: Get candidate character thumbnails (used by the picker card). args `{pick_id}`.
actions.studio_cast.result: Check whether the user has picked (use after a web or embedded pick). args `{pick_id}`; returns `status` waiting or chosen, and `refs`.
actions.studio_confirm.show: Show a quote approval card (`confirm_token`) or permission card (`permission_token`); does not charge or consume the token. args `{confirm_token|permission_token, summary?, what?}`.
actions.studio_confirm.decide: Record the user's decision; called by the card when the user taps, the agent should not call it itself. For `approval: "user"` tokens it can only decline; approving returns `user_required` and the user must approve on `approve_url`. args `{confirm_token|permission_token, decision:'approve'|'decline'}`.
actions.studio_confirm.wait: Call right after `show` (or after giving the user the `approve_url`) to wait for the user's decision (up to 50 s; `open` means undecided, call again). args `{confirm_token|permission_token, timeout_sec?}`.
actions.studio_browse.show: Show the library card. args `{pillar?: avatars|environments|items|outputs}`; returns the list (latest 60).
actions.studio_browse.list: Get a tab's list (used by the library card). args `{pillar}`.
actions.studio_browse.thumbs: Get thumbnail data URIs (used by the library card). args `{pillar, ids:[≤24]}`.
actions.studio_collage.guide: One-page flow guide: gates, modes, models and durations, which action to use at each step, and how to handle errors.
actions.studio_collage.options: Available animation models (duration range, tier, whether usable now), aspect ratios, modes and still resolutions.
actions.studio_collage.auto: AI director: create a board from `brief` with required `budget_hwt` cap (plus `seconds`, `mode`, `aspect`, …); returns `board_id`, then loop `auto_step`. With `board_id` pauses/resumes or sets budget.
actions.studio_collage.auto_step: Paid: run the AI director's next step within budget; returns `do`: `wait`, `done` (`film_output_id`, `qa_verdict`), `stop` (`why`) or `paused`, with `spent_hwt`, `left_hwt` and progress.
actions.studio_collage.plan: Create a board. args `{text (narration, max 12 sentences), mode?: flow|solo, aspect?, title?, language?, brief?, video_wf?, video_res?, still_res?, hold_sec?, style?, …}`.
actions.studio_collage.replan: Regenerate the three concepts (clears per-sentence work). args may change `{text, brief, mode, aspect, language, title}`.
actions.studio_collage.list: List the user's collage boards (id, status, sentence count, approved count, stills/animations count, final `output_id`).
actions.studio_collage.get: Get everything about a board: `status`, `concepts[]`, `pick`, `beats[]` (line, meaning, thesis, objects, carry, bg, sec, approved, still, video), `film`, `qa`, plus the suggested next step.
actions.studio_collage.pick: Pick a concept. args `{concept: 0|1|2}`; the per-sentence metaphors are then written in the background (10-40 s; existing sentences are rewritten in bulk).
actions.studio_collage.revise: Rewrite one sentence's metaphor from a note. args `{n, note}`; it must be re-approved afterwards.
actions.studio_collage.edit: Edit directly without AI (free). args `{params?:{aspect, mode, video_wf, …}, beats?:[{n, meaning?, objects?, bg?, sec?, trans?, approved?, …}]}`; the response lists stale stills/animations.
actions.studio_collage.approve: Approve in bulk. args `{what: beats|stills, ns?:[sentence numbers] (default all), ok?: false (withdraw)}`; stills can only be approved where an image exists (others return `skipped`).
actions.studio_collage.quote: Quote without charging. args `{what: stills|videos, ns?}`; returns `fee_hwt` per sentence, `total_hwt`, and why some sentences cannot be produced (`skipped`).
actions.studio_collage.render_stills: Paid: render one still per sentence. args `{ns?, refs?:[…] (max 3), seed?}`; returns job ids, then `collect`.
actions.studio_collage.render_videos: Paid: render first/last-frame animations (one per sentence: empty paper to still in `solo` and for sentence 1, previous still to this still in `flow`). args `{ns?}`; returns job ids, then `collect`.
actions.studio_collage.collect: Collect results: checks submitted stills/animations, attaches finished ones to their sentence (`collected[]`) and records failure reasons (money is refunded automatically).
actions.studio_collage.adopt: Use an existing library output as a sentence's still or animation. args `{n, what: still|video, output_id}`.
actions.studio_collage.view: View a comparison image (returns an image): one row per sentence with animation first/middle/last frame and the still; use it for the user to approve stills or to check joins.
actions.studio_collage.film: Stitch the film for free. args `{hold_sec?}`; sentences without an animation are skipped (returned as `missing`); stitching runs in the background, check `film.status` with `get`.
actions.studio_collage.qa: Acceptance check: `legs[]` of `empty_start`, `end_match`, `carry`, `rhythm`, `rest` and `silent`, each `pass|warn|fail` with the offending sentence numbers in `items`, plus a `verdict`.
actions.studio_collage.delete: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete this board (stills, animations and films already in the library are not deleted).
actions.studio_paper.guide: One-page flow guide plus the catalog of all moves (transitions, cameras, effects, backdrops, props, sound effects, music).
actions.studio_paper.options: All available moves: cuts, cameras, looks, entrances, moves, effects, backdrops, props, sfx, beds, layout.
actions.studio_paper.plan: Create a board. args `{topic (4-1500 chars), seconds? 12-30, language?, title?, voice?, mascot?, backdrops?, bed?, still_res?, notes?, refs?}`; returns `board_id`; script is AI-written in background.
actions.studio_paper.list: List the user's paper explainers (id, topic, scene count, final `output_id`).
actions.studio_paper.get: Get everything about a board: `stage`, `plan` (script, scenes, elements), `art`, `voice`, `board`, `render`, plus the next step.
actions.studio_paper.revise: Have AI rewrite from a note. args `{note}`; it must be re-approved afterwards.
actions.studio_paper.edit: Edit directly without AI (free). args `{scenes?:[{n, say?, banner?, bg?, cut?, cam?, look?, els?, fx?, sfx?}], parts?:[{key, desc}], hook?, bed?}`; names must come from `options`.
actions.studio_paper.approve: Approve. args `{what: plan|board, ok?: false (withdraw)}`; call only after the user approves in person.
actions.studio_paper.quote: Quote without charging. args `{what: art|render, keys?}`.
actions.studio_paper.render_art: Paid: draw the elements (up to 6 per sheet; without `keys` all missing ones). args `{keys?, seed?}`; returns job ids, then `collect`.
actions.studio_paper.collect: Collect results: finished elements are cut out automatically (`collected`/`pending`/`failed`); redraw missing ones with `render_art {keys}` (failed orders are refunded).
actions.studio_paper.adopt: Use an existing library image as an element. args `{key, output_id}`.
actions.studio_paper.voice: Free: synthesize narration, time the scenes to the real speech length, and produce music and sound effects. args `{voice?}` (30-90 s in the background).
actions.studio_paper.storyboard: Free: one still per scene (goes into the Storyboard folder); these props are the film's props.
actions.studio_paper.view: View the contact sheet (returns an image). args `{what?: board|parts}`; always show it to the user before approving the storyboard.
actions.studio_paper.render: Paid: render the video, billed per second (a confirmation is returned above the threshold); returns `job_id`, then `get` until `stage:'done'`.
actions.studio_paper.delete: Destructive (needs `confirm: true`): delete this board (elements and voice track are deleted; finished films in the library are not).
